استعلمتم (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْتُمْ (istaʕlamtum) /is.taʕ.lam.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اُسْتُعْلِمْتُمْ (ustuʕlimtum) /us.tuʕ.lim.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
